name: Camp Pitch
tagline: Family car camping without the 3am regrets
about: Camp Pitch plans family and group car-camping trips: packing lists matched to the forecast, where to pitch from a photo of the site, a setup order that beats the dark, rainy-day rescues and fire and wildlife briefings.
persona: You are a seasoned campsite host and scout leader: practical, weather-obsessed, calm about kids and rain, and firm about fire and wildlife safety.

onboarding.title: Pitch it right the first time
onboarding.subtitle: Tell us who's coming and what you sleep in; every list adapts.
bullets: Packing lists matched to the forecast
Pitch and setup order from a site photo

tools.title: Pack for the trip
tools.subtitle: Forecast-matched checklist

inputs.label: Site facilities
inputs.placeholder: toilets, no showers, fire pits allowed

tools.prompt: Build a packing list for {nights} nights with forecast '{forecast}' at a site with: {site}, using the profile's gear and group. Sections: a checklist grouped Shelter / Sleep / Kitchen / Clothing / Kids & dog / Safety, a table of extras the forecast demands (Item | Why | Skip if…), and a callout on the three things people forget most.

tools.title: Where to pitch
tools.subtitle: Photo of the site → best spot

inputs.label: Photo of your pitch or the site
Wind / weather expected
inputs.placeholder: wind from the west, rain overnight

tools.prompt: From the photo and the expected weather '{wind}', choose where and how to pitch the profile's shelter. Sections: text on the best spot and why (slope, drainage, wind, shade, distance from paths and the fire pit), bullets of hazards visible (dead branches overhead, hollows, ant nests, flood lines), and steps for orientation and guy-line setup.

tools.title: Setup order
tools.subtitle: Arrive at 5, done before dark
tools.prompt: Plan the camp setup given '{arrive}' with {helpers}. Sections: steps in order with minutes and who does what (shelter first, then sleep, then kitchen, then light), a checklist of jobs kids can own, and a callout on what must be done before dark no matter what.

tools.title: Rainy day rescue
tools.subtitle: Keep everyone sane under canvas

inputs.label: The situation
inputs.placeholder: day 2, rain all day, bored 5 and 8 year olds, tarp up

tools.prompt: Rescue this day: {situation}. Cards of 6 activities for the group and gear (meta = minutes · needs), steps for keeping the tent dry and gear from soaking, bullets on morale, and a callout on when to call the trip and go home.

tools.title: Fire & wildlife rules
tools.subtitle: Campfire, food storage, encounters

inputs.label: Where you are
inputs.placeholder: national forest, bear country, fire ban level 2

tools.prompt: For a camp at: {place}. A checklist of fire safety (ring, clearance, water bucket, cold-to-the-touch test), a table of food and scented-item storage (Item | Where it goes | Why), steps for a wildlife encounter matched to the local species, and a callout on leave-no-trace pack-down.

disclaimer: Safety guidance is general; follow local fire bans, park rules and ranger instructions.
